memories.title: Virtual Filesystem Host Escalation Prevention
memories.content: Commands attempting host escalation (sudo, chroot, /etc access, rm -rf /) must be blocked at the execution boundary and return exit code 126.

memories.title: Authoritative Persistent Data Store Boundary
memories.content: PostgreSQL is the authoritative production data store. Connected services such as Google Drive are backup mirrors and must never replace database state or report synchronization prematurely.

memories.title: Destructive Operation Human Approval Barrier
memories.content: Any task action modifying file systems, resetting databases, or revoking credentials requires explicit human approval in the queue before execution.
